name: volunteer name present
description: The volunteer’s full name appears on the receipt.

name: amount present
description: The amount paid to the volunteer is stated.

name: date inside project period
description: The document date falls inside the project period.

name: fecha requerida
description: La fecha del documento es obligatoria para justificar el gasto. Buscar en cabecera, en el billete o en el membrete del hotel.

name: importe total requerido
description: El importe total es imprescindible. Para dietas calcular días × tarifa si no aparece un total explícito.

name: beneficiario requerido
description: El nombre del viajero/beneficiario es obligatorio para justificar a quién corresponde el gasto.

name: destino requerido
description: El destino es necesario para validar que el viaje está relacionado con actividades del proyecto.

name: motivo recomendado
description: El motivo del viaje debe estar justificado. Si no aparece en el documento puede constar en documentación complementaria.

name: moneda requerida
description: Identificar la moneda para conversión si es necesario. EUR por defecto en documentos en español.

name: empleado requerido
description: El nombre del trabajador es imprescindible para identificar a quién corresponde la nómina.

name: periodo requerido
description: El período de liquidación (mes/año) es obligatorio para identificar a qué mes corresponde el gasto.

name: bruto requerido
description: El salario bruto es el punto de partida del cálculo salarial. Es obligatorio.

name: neto requerido
description: El salario neto (líquido a percibir) es obligatorio como verificación del importe final pagado.

name: imputacion valida
description: El porcentaje de imputación al proyecto debe estar entre 0 y 100%.

name: empleado requerido
description: Nombre del empleado de sede obligatorio.

name: periodo requerido
description: Período de liquidación obligatorio para personal en sede.

name: bruto requerido
description: Salario bruto obligatorio para personal en sede.

name: neto requerido
description: Salario neto obligatorio para personal en sede.

name: imputacion valida
description: El porcentaje de dedicación al proyecto debe estar entre 0 y 100%.

name: proveedor requerido
description: El nombre del proveedor es obligatorio en facturas de equipos.

name: numero factura requerido
description: El número de factura es obligatorio para equipos y materiales. Sin él no se puede justificar el gasto.

name: fecha requerida
description: La fecha de factura es obligatoria.

name: descripcion requerida
description: La descripción del equipo o material es necesaria para justificar la elegibilidad del gasto en el proyecto.

name: total requerido
description: El importe total de la factura es obligatorio.

name: fecha requerida
description: La fecha es obligatoria incluso en tickets simplificados.

name: total requerido
description: El importe total es obligatorio.

name: descripcion requerida
description: La descripción de los artículos es necesaria para justificar la elegibilidad del gasto.

name: expense description sufficient
description: The travel expense is described precisely enough to justify it for the project: who travelled, route or destination, dates and purpose. Fuel invoices name the vehicle (plate number) or generator the fuel was for; parking, taxi or transport tickets state the trip or activity they relate to. Fails for vague descriptions.
hint: Quote the description you read. Missing plate numbers on vehicle costs are a failure.

name: project execution within period
description: The document date (invoice or receipt issue date, or the pay period for payroll and allowances) is between the configured limit and the configured limit inclusive, and any payment date shown is on or after the configured limit. Fails if a date is outside this window; state the date found.
hint: Use the issue date of the invoice or receipt, or the period paid for payroll and allowances.

name: proof of payment attached
description: Proof of payment for this expense is attached and fits the payment method: (a) cash: the invoice or a receipt is signed or stamped by the supplier with the payment date and a mention such as 'payé', 'reçu', 'acquitté', 'pour acquit', 'cash', 'paid' or 'received'; (b) cheque: a copy of the cheque made out to the supplier plus the bank statement showing it was debited; (c) bank transfer: the bank statement or transfer confirmation showing the debit. The amount paid matches the invoice total. The method stated on the invoice matches the evidence (an invoice stating payment by transfer or cheque is not proven by a cash note). If one payment (cheque, transfer or cash advance) covers several invoices, a breakdown showing this invoice's amount within that payment is attached. Fails if proof is missing, does not fit the method or amount, or a combined payment has no breakdown.
hint: Identify the payment method first (invoice wording, cheque, bank document, receipt), then check the evidence that method requires. Name the page_num of each proof.

name: documentation match
description: Supporting documents in the file (funds or purchase request, pro forma or quote, purchase order, delivery note, payment voucher, cheque, discharge/décharge) agree with the invoice in amount, quantity, item description and period, and their dates follow a plausible order: request, quote and order on or before the invoice date; payment on or after the invoice date unless the invoice states it was an advance payment. Fails on any contradiction between documents (e.g. a quote for a different quantity, an order for different items, a discharge for a different month, a request dated after the payment). Passes if the invoice has no supporting documents.
hint: List each supporting page with its date, amount and quantity, then compare with the invoice. Name the page_num of any contradiction.

name: non eligible expense
description: The expense is not a non-eligible cost: promotion of the organisation itself or its partners, bank or debit interest, fines, penalties, surcharges or late-payment charges, legal or court costs, protocol or hospitality expenses (gifts, flowers, decorations, receptions, meals with guests, show tickets), severance pay, or depreciation of previously bought assets. Fails if any line is such a cost; name the line.
hint: Read every line item and flag only clearly non-eligible items.

name: aexcid stamp complete
description: Every expense document in the file (invoice, receipt, payslip or allowance receipt) charged to AEXCID bears the AEXCID funding stamp, and the stamp shows all four items: (1) the project file number (expediente; expected: any file number); (2) the caption 'funded by AEXCID-Junta de Extremadura' in any language; (3) the percentage charged to AEXCID, written even when it is 100%; (4) the amount charged to AEXCID, which equals that percentage of the document total and does not exceed it. Fails if the stamp is missing on any expense document or any of the four items is blank, illegible or inconsistent with the total.
hint: Find the AEXCID rubber stamp (usually near the total or the signature). Check the four items one by one and name the missing one.

name: invoice arithmetic correct
description: Arithmetic is correct on every invoice and receipt in the file: for each line, quantity × unit price equals the line total; the line totals add up to the stated total (after any discount, tax or deposit shown); and where the total is also written in words (e.g. 'Arrêtée la présente facture à la somme de ...'), the amount in words equals the amount in figures. Ignore differences of 1 currency unit or less. When it fails, name the line and both values.
hint: Recompute every line yourself instead of trusting the printed line totals. Convert the amount in words to a number before comparing.

name: supplier identification complete
description: Each invoice identifies the supplier with: business or person name, an address (street, district or town), and a tax identification number (NIF) or a company/trade register number (RCCM or equivalent). Fails if the name or address is missing, or if both the tax ID and the register number are missing. A receipt from an informal-market supplier with no invoice obligation passes if it shows the supplier's name and signature.
hint: Look in the letterhead, header and footer for NIF, RCCM, N° contribuable or registre du commerce.

name: client identification complete
description: Each invoice is made out to the beneficiary organisation, a consortium partner or the local partner, written with its full legal name (accepted names: not configured; any full legal name of the organisation). Fails if the client is missing, is a private person, or is only an acronym or short name instead of the full legal name.
hint: Read the 'Client', 'Doit', 'Facturé à' or 'Bill to' field.

name: tax treatment stated
description: Each invoice states its tax treatment: a VAT/TVA or equivalent local tax amount, or an explicit statement that tax is included ('TTC', 'TVA incluse', 'VAT included', 'IVA incluido'), or a stated exemption or non-liability (e.g. 'exonéré', 'non assujetti', 'TVA non applicable', reference to an exemption or simplified tax regime). Fails if the invoice shows amounts excluding tax ('HT', 'hors taxes') with no tax line, no 'tax included' statement and no exemption. A receipt from an informal-market supplier with no invoice obligation passes.
hint: Look at the totals block and the footer. 'HT' alone, without a tax line, 'TTC' or an exemption, is a failure.

name: single expense documents
description: All pages relate to the same expense (same supplier or payee, amount, date and purpose). Fails if (a) a page belongs to a different expense (different amount, supplier, payee or date with no link to this one), or (b) the file contains several invoices or receipts, from different suppliers or for different amounts, without a settlement statement that lists each one and reconciles them to the total paid (e.g. the settlement of a cash advance). Name the page_num of each unrelated page.
hint: Compare amount, supplier and date on every page with the main document. Several receipts are fine only with a statement that adds them up.

name: budget line fit
description: The expense belongs under AEXCID line A.6 Travel, accommodation and subsistence: transport tickets, accommodation, subsistence, or fuel for project trips. Fails if it is mainly something else, e.g. vehicle repair or maintenance (A.7), vehicle insurance or equipment (A.4), or routine office running costs (A.8).
hint: Judge only what the documents show; there is no approved budget to compare against.

name: air travel boarding pass economy
description: If the expense includes air travel, a boarding pass for each flight is attached and the travel class is economy. Passes when there is no air travel.
hint: Look for boarding passes, e-tickets and the fare class (Economy, Y, M).

name: travel allowance limits
description: Accommodation abroad does not exceed the configured limit per night and subsistence abroad does not exceed the configured limit per day (VAT included); fuel claimed per kilometre does not exceed the configured limit per km. Passes when the document contains none of these items.
hint: Divide hotel totals by the number of nights and per-diem totals by the number of days before comparing.

Fails if the invoice shows amounts excluding tax ('HT', 'hors taxes') with no tax line, no 'tax included' statement and no exemption. A receipt from an informal-market supplier with no invoice obligation passes.
hint: Look at the totals block and the footer. 'HT' alone, without a tax line, 'TTC' or an exemption, is a failure.

name: single expense documents
description: All pages relate to the same expense (same supplier or payee, amount, date and purpose). Fails if (a) a page belongs to a different expense (different amount, supplier, payee or date with no link to this one), or (b) the file contains several invoices or receipts, from different suppliers or for different amounts, without a settlement statement that lists each one and reconciles them to the total paid (e.g. the settlement of a cash advance). Name the page_num of each unrelated page.
hint: Compare amount, supplier and date on every page with the main document. Several receipts are fine only with a statement that adds them up.

name: budget line fit
description: The expense belongs under AEXCID line A.4.c Consumables: materials and supplies used up in project activities. Fails if it is mainly durable equipment (A.4.a), repair, maintenance or other services (A.7), travel or fuel for trips (A.6), or routine office running costs such as electricity, water, communications or cleaning (A.8).
hint: Judge only what the documents show; there is no approved budget to compare against.

name: aexcid stamp complete
description: Every expense document in the file (invoice, receipt, payslip or allowance receipt) charged to AEXCID bears the AEXCID funding stamp, and the stamp shows all four items: (1) the project file number (expediente; expected: any file number); (2) the caption 'funded by AEXCID-Junta de Extremadura' in any language; (3) the percentage charged to AEXCID, written even when it is 100%; (4) the amount charged to AEXCID, which equals that percentage of the document total and does not exceed it. Fails if the stamp is missing on any expense document or any of the four items is blank, illegible or inconsistent with the total.
hint: Find the AEXCID rubber stamp (usually near the total or the signature). Check the four items one by one and name the missing one.

name: volunteer agreement present
description: A volunteer agreement (convention or contrat de volontariat), assignment letter or equivalent document for the named volunteer is attached, signed by the organisation and the volunteer, and covers the period being charged (AEXCID A.5.d, Law 45/2015 on Volunteering).
hint: Look for 'convention de volontariat', 'contrat d'engagement', 'lettre d'affectation'.

name: volunteer allowance basis documented
description: A document that sets the allowance or bonus amount for this volunteer, or allows it to be checked (clause of the volunteer agreement, allowance grid, internal decision or memo), is attached, and the amount paid matches it.
hint: The receipt itself does not establish the amount; look for a separate document that sets it.

name: volunteer receipt complete
description: A receipt (décharge) for the allowance names the volunteer, the payer organisation, the amount, the date and the month or period the allowance is for, and is signed by the volunteer and by the person handing over the funds. The period on the receipt is the period being charged.
hint: Compare the month on the décharge with the month being claimed.

name: proof of payment attached
description: Proof that the volunteer allowance was paid is attached and fits the payment method: cash: a receipt signed by the volunteer acknowledging the amount, with the date; bank or mobile-money transfer: the statement or transfer confirmation showing the amount paid to the volunteer; cheque: a copy of the cheque plus the bank statement. The amount paid matches the allowance charged. If one payment covers several volunteers, a list showing this volunteer's amount is attached.
hint: Name the page_num of the proof of payment and the method it shows.

name: project execution within period
description: The document date (invoice or receipt issue date, or the pay period for payroll and allowances) is between the configured limit and the configured limit inclusive, and any payment date shown is on or after the configured limit. Fails if a date is outside this window; state the date found.
hint: Use the issue date of the invoice or receipt, or the period paid for payroll and allowances.

name: documentation match
description: Supporting documents in the file (volunteer list, attendance or activity record, allowance grid, payment list) agree with the claim in volunteer name, amount and period. Fails on any contradiction between documents. Passes if there are no supporting documents.
hint: List each supporting page with its date, amount and quantity, then compare with the invoice. Name the page_num of any contradiction.

Fails if (a) a page belongs to a different expense (different amount, supplier, payee or date with no link to this one), or (b) the file contains several invoices or receipts, from different suppliers or for different amounts, without a settlement statement that lists each one and reconciles them to the total paid (e.g. the settlement of a cash advance). hint: Compare amount, supplier and date on every page with the main document. Several receipts are fine only with a statement that adds them up.

Fails if the stamp is missing on any expense document or any of the four items is blank, illegible or inconsistent with the total.
hint: Find the AEXCID rubber stamp (usually near the total or the signature). Check the four items one by one and name the missing one.

name: proof of payment attached
description: Proof of payment for this expense is attached and fits the payment method: (a) cash: the invoice or a receipt is signed or stamped by the supplier with the payment date and a mention such as 'payé', 'reçu', 'acquitté', 'pour acquit', 'cash', 'paid' or 'received'; (b) cheque: a copy of the cheque made out to the supplier plus the bank statement showing it was debited; (c) bank transfer: the bank statement or transfer confirmation showing the debit. The amount paid matches the invoice total. The method stated on the invoice matches the evidence (an invoice stating payment by transfer or cheque is not proven by a cash note). If one payment (cheque, transfer or cash advance) covers several invoices, a breakdown showing this invoice's amount within that payment is attached. Fails if proof is missing, does not fit the method or amount, or a combined payment has no breakdown.
hint: Identify the payment method first (invoice wording, cheque, bank document, receipt), then check the evidence that method requires. Name the page_num of each proof.

name: invoice arithmetic correct
description: Arithmetic is correct on every invoice and receipt in the file: for each line, quantity × unit price equals the line total; the line totals add up to the stated total (after any discount, tax or deposit shown); and where the total is also written in words (e.g. 'Arrêtée la présente facture à la somme de ...'), the amount in words equals the amount in figures. Ignore differences of 1 currency unit or less. When it fails, name the line and both values.
hint: Recompute every line yourself instead of trusting the printed line totals. Convert the amount in words to a number before comparing.

name: supplier identification complete
description: Each invoice identifies the supplier with: business or person name, an address (street, district or town), and a tax identification number (NIF) or a company/trade register number (RCCM or equivalent). Fails if the name or address is missing, or if both the tax ID and the register number are missing. A receipt from an informal-market supplier with no invoice obligation passes if it shows the supplier's name and signature.
hint: Look in the letterhead, header and footer for NIF, RCCM, N° contribuable or registre du commerce.

name: client identification complete
description: Each invoice is made out to the beneficiary organisation, a consortium partner or the local partner, written with its full legal name (accepted names: not configured; any full legal name of the organisation). Fails if the client is missing, is a private person, or is only an acronym or short name instead of the full legal name.
hint: Read the 'Client', 'Doit', 'Facturé à' or 'Bill to' field.

name: tax treatment stated

name: documentation match
description: Supporting documents in the file (funds or purchase request, pro forma or quote, purchase order, delivery note, payment voucher, cheque, discharge/décharge) agree with the invoice in amount, quantity, item description and period, and their dates follow a plausible order: request, quote and order on or before the invoice date; payment on or after the invoice date unless the invoice states it was an advance payment. Fails on any contradiction between documents (e.g. a quote for a different quantity, an order for different items, a discharge for a different month, a request dated after the payment). Passes if the invoice has no supporting documents.
hint: List each supporting page with its date, amount and quantity, then compare with the invoice. Name the page_num of any contradiction.

name: expense description sufficient
description: The invoice describes the service precisely: the tasks carried out, the time spent or duration (or estimated time), and the rate or unit price (AEXCID A.7). Repair, maintenance or washing of a vehicle names the vehicle (plate number); work on a generator or installation names the equipment or site. Fails for vague descriptions such as 'réparation' or 'prestation' with no detail.
hint: Quote the description you read. Missing plate numbers on vehicle costs are a failure.

name: service contract present
description: A service contract, engagement letter, work order or accepted quote for the service is attached (AEXCID A.7). Fails if no document shows the service was commissioned.
hint: Look for 'contrat', 'bon de commande', 'ordre de service', 'devis accepté'.

name: budget line fit
description: The expense belongs under AEXCID line A.7 Technical and professional services: services, technical assistance or consultancy for project activities, including repair and maintenance of equipment and vehicles. Fails if it is mainly goods (A.4), routine office running costs such as communications, electricity or rent (A.8), or travel and fuel (A.6).
hint: Judge only what the documents show; there is no approved budget to compare against.

name: three quotes required
description: If this purchase of supplies, equipment or services exceeds the configured limit, at least three quotes from different suppliers (or a documented justification that there are not enough suppliers) are attached. Contracts must not be split to stay under the threshold. Passes when the amount is below the threshold.
hint: Compare the invoice total with the threshold in the same currency, then look for quotes or a bid summary.

name: non eligible expense
description: The expense is not a non-eligible cost: promotion of the organisation itself or its partners, bank or debit interest, fines, penalties, surcharges or late-payment charges, legal or court costs, protocol or hospitality expenses (gifts, flowers, decorations, receptions, meals with guests, show tickets), severance pay, or depreciation of previously bought assets. Fails if any line is such a cost; name the line.
hint: Read every line item and flag only clearly non-eligible items.
